name: Berain
verdict: Saudi bottled-water company. Hassana, the investment manager of Saudi Arabia's GOSI, acquired 40% in March 2025; Rajhi Invest holds the rest.
note: Berain's mark appears as a patch on the right chest of Al-Fateh's 2026/27 home shirt (Saudi Pro League kit gallery photo) and Berain is on the club's partners list. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Hassana, the investment manager of the General Organization for Social Insurance (GOSI) — described by Just Drinks as 'the government agency concerned with social insurance' — bought 40% of Berain in March 2025 (berain-hassana-stake), which would put a Saudi state-linked fund at 5% or more without control; Rajhi Invest, the family office of Mohammed Abdulaziz Al-Rajhi & Sons, holds the remainder. Saudi Arabia's record is on main (saudi-executions-2024, saudi-executions-2025). Proposed tier: concern.
